apiEvidenceFromServerLog.note: Triggered by dashboard automatically; 202 does not prove Google work completed.

serverWarnings: PostgreSQL driver warns that concurrent client.query calls are deprecated and will be removed in pg@9.0.

findings.observed: Marketing promises Photos compress before upload, contradicting permanent photo/video upload removal.
Every tool listed here ships today is stated before required acceptance evidence is complete.
Initial primary navigation includes Logistics as a separate pillar; target plan places it within Team and uses five primary destinations.
AI setup explanation emphasizes team provider keys and does not explain personal Codex pairing.

harnessIssueResolved.observed: First local OTP was rejected with 400 because bare dev-otp.mjs used its default secret rather than the dev server's configured secret.
harnessIssueResolved.resolution: Read the configured development environment using node --env-file=apps/web/.env.development.local scripts/dev-otp.mjs owner@example.test and submit through visible UI.
harnessIssueResolved.classification: Harness configuration, not an application authentication failure.

limitations: Local controlled fixture only; production email delivery, signup, provisioning, invitations, role boundaries, and connector execution are separate acceptance journeys.
Updated legal notice rendered but legal acceptance was not submitted in this journey.
No auth cookies were injected and no direct UI HTTP requests were used.
